body:
We make Kiron, so weigh this post knowing that. It isn't a real post: it's the sample the tests read (test/blog.test.mjs), and a copy dropped into content/blog shows how each block looks.

The short answer

  • Pick app one if you want a program to follow.
  • Pick app two if you only want a log.
  • Pick app three if you never pay for apps.

Prices checked {{kiron:checked}}.

A table with a header row

Five columns, the most a comparison post uses. On a phone the table scrolls sideways inside its box, and the first column stays put.
